item.title: Fishing & Animal Taming in 99 Nights in the Forest
item.description:
Fishing is the most famous side activity in 99 Nights in the Forest — because it hides a working chat code. Taming is the animal companion system that helps gatherers and scouts.

Fishing — unlock and use

  1. Upgrade your Campfire to level 2.
  2. Craft/obtain the fishing rod.
  3. Go to a fishing spot and cast the rod into the water.
  4. Wait for the bite, then reel in.

item.title: Forest Rage Hard Mode in 99 Nights in the Forest — Corruption, Rifts & Research Outpost
item.description:
Forest Rage is the hard-mode layer of 99 Nights in the Forest — reached after the main run, it raises threat scaling and adds the Corruption mechanic, Rift clearing and the Research Outpost end-game objective.

⚠️ In progress: This guide is part of the writing queue — the systems below are the confirmed direction (Corruption / Rift clearing / Research Outpost) with the detailed numbers and strats being verified. Treat everything as framework content for now.

What changes in Forest Rage

  • Threat scaling — monsters hit harder, spawn earlier and scale faster.
  • Corruption — corrupted zones spread across the map and must be managed.
  • Rifts — clearing Rifts is the way to push back Corruption.
  • Research Outpost — the late-game objective that ties the hard-mode loop together.

How to prepare

  1. Max the campfire and bench before entering — hard mode punishes weak cores.
  2. Stockpile wood and food — double what a normal run needs.
  3. Collect Modifier Flames early — Flames are the real damage multiplier in hard mode.
  4. Squad up — hard mode is brutal solo.

The hard-mode loop (framework)

  1. Day: clear Corruption at the edges, gather, upgrade.
  2. Dusk: close the base — hard-mode nights attack harder and smarter.
  3. Rift windows: when a Rift is active, a strike squad clears it to reduce Corruption pressure.
  4. Outpost: repair and research at the Research Outpost to progress the final objective.

Current knowledge gaps

  • Exact Corruption spread rate and Rift timers — being verified.
  • Research Outpost repair costs — being verified.
  • Whether late nights change the spawn schedule — being verified.

New findings land in Updates — and in the video section as walkthroughs become available.

item.title: Modifier Flames in 99 Nights in the Forest — What They Do and How to Use Them
item.description:
Modifier Flames are upgrade items that attach to your weapons and tools to change how they behave. They’re one of the main reasons late-game loadouts feel completely different from early-game ones.

What Flames do

  • Modify equipment — attach to a weapon/tool to change its properties (damage type, effects, resource yield).
  • Stack with tiers — a good Flame on an upgraded weapon beats a plain top-tier weapon.
  • Are random — code rewards like forestwakesup26 grant random Flames, so collection is part of the loop.

How to get Flames

  • Code rewards — e.g. the current working code gives 3 random Flames (see Codes).
  • Gameplay drops — late-night kills and event content drop Flames.

How to apply them

  1. Open your inventory/equipment menu.
  2. Select the weapon or tool you want to modify.
  3. Attach the Flame (check the compatibility note — some Flames only fit certain item types).
  4. Confirm — the item’s stats update immediately.

Quick tips

  • Don’t waste good Flames on starter tools — wait until mid-tier at least.
  • Match Flame type to role — combat classes want damage Flames; Lumberjack/Scavenger prefer resource-yield Flames.
  • Flames are often the difference in Forest Rage hard mode — start collecting early.
⚠️ Verify in-game: Flame names, effects and compatibility are balance-sensitive — confirm the current behavior in-game before planning builds around a specific Flame.

item.title: Weapons & Tools in 99 Nights in the Forest — Crafting Tiers and Loadouts
item.description:
Your crafting bench is the whole economy of 99 Nights in the Forest. Everything you survive with — tools, weapons, armor, map and compass — comes out of it, and its upgrade level gates what you can build.

Crafting bench tiers (framework)

The bench upgrades unlock recipe groups in order. The exact item names and material costs shift with updates — this is the progression shape, not a fixed price table.
